command/src/main/java/com/jagrosh/jdauti.summary: `AnnotatedModuleCompiler` defines runtime conversion of objects annotated with `JDACommand.Module` into `Command` instances, enabling annotation-based command creation in the JDA command framework.
`CommandBuilder` provides a chain-setter utility to dynamically construct `Command` instances at runtime. It serves as a flexible alternative to extending the base `Command` class.
`Command` defines the blueprint for executable bot commands, providing configuration fields and the abstract `execute(CommandEvent)` method as the core component of the command framework.
`CommandClient` defines the core bot configuration and data interface. It serves as the primary contract for managing commands, owners, and execution contexts.
